This rice plot is small but rice needs feeding to give good grain, so I will buy one bag of NPK and maybe a little urea if money allows — my other plots also need fertilizer so I must share what I can afford. I plant seed I saved from last year, because the agro-dealer in town is far and improved seed costs too much. I will spray herbicide because weeding rice by hand takes too many days, and I will call my brothers and two hired hands for transplanting and harvest.
